question: Should OpenClaw adopt `CLAW.md` as the canonical exported representation for the experimental Claws lifecycle once the preceding lifecycle stack is accepted?
rationale: This is a new user-facing package-format and export-contract direction, not a mechanical bug fix; its correct owner boundary and compatibility commitment depend on maintainer acceptance of the broader experimental stack.

options.title: Accept the staged format direction
options.body: Keep `CLAW.md` as the canonical export artifact, contingent on landing the prerequisite lifecycle stages and obtaining final-stack compatibility and runtime proof.

options.title: Retain JSON export for now
options.body: Keep JSON as the canonical export format until the lifecycle experiment and external package contract are independently accepted.

recommendation.title: Accept the staged format direction
